launch_gate: Do not submit before the independent RepeatMasker full-panel audit verifies one completed checksum-valid annotation receipt for each of the 526 manifest taxa.
scope: For every manifest taxon, parse all checksum-verified RepeatMasker instances and link them to the independently read-back gene-order table. The stage preserves overlaps and nearest-boundary ties. It yields coordinate covariates only and does not infer repeat-mediated rearrangement, causality, duplication, orthology, or protein structural change.
